lines.speaker: SARAH
lines.text: Frankie's dead. Rizzo's taking over Philly. Testify, give us Rizzo, and your family stays safe[cite: 36, 37].

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: Witness protection? In Philly? They'd find me in a week[cite: 36, 38, 39].

lines.speaker: SARAH
lines.text: This is what you fight for. Your call[cite: 40].
